timestamp_policy.signal_time: completion proxy of the small reversal bar
timestamp_policy.larger_asof_rule: latest larger bar with completion proxy strictly earlier than the small signal time
timestamp_policy.same_second_policy: excluded from primary results and retained for primary-feature sensitivity only
timestamp_policy.session_boundary: 18:00 in the export timestamp's unresolved timezone

primary_hypotheses.strong_close_structure_break: favorable close-location fraction at least 0.80 and the reversal bar trades beyond the preceding bar's directional extreme
primary_hypotheses.strict_strong_close_structure_break: favorable close-location fraction at least 0.80 and the reversal closes beyond the preceding bar's directional extreme
primary_hypotheses.exhaustion_context: small reversal is countertrend to the latest strictly-prior completed larger bar and that larger run contains at least 8 completed bars
